Subject: Realtime: production outage - capacity spike impacting inference

Vanessa —

We’re seeing a large unexpected traffic spike on our fraud-scoring endpoint that uses your hosted API. Latency has jumped from <200ms to ~3s and error rates are climbing (5xx on token stream). This started ~08:30 PT after a campaign launch.

We need immediate options: can we burst into dedicated capacity, or do we need Private VPC for our compliance needs? We’re willing to sign a short-term commitment if it helps keep customers online.

I’m available for a quick call now. Attaching a small snippet of the incident log and a traffic graph for context.

Attachments: incident_log_snippet.txt (text), traffic_graph.png (image)

—Elaine

Date: 2026-02-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Realtime: production outage - capacity spike impacting inference

Hi Elaine — thanks for the heads up and the logs. I’m pulling in the team now. Quick notes from what I can see:
- Error signatures look like request queuing + a few model OOMs under your recent burst profile.
- Hosted tier should handle transient spikes but we may be hitting a sustained concurrency pattern that benefits from Dedicated.

Immediate options:
1) Short-term: increase hosted concurrency quota + prefix caching (minutes) while we triage.
2) 48–72h: Spin up Dedicated pool (reserved GPUs) to absorb sustained high throughput.
3) If you require network isolation / audit controls, Private (VPC) is the path — longer lead time (weeks) and legal work.

I can do a call at 09:20 PT. If you can share the expected steady-state qps after the campaign, that will help scope Dedicated sizing.

I’ll loop in Marcus (sales lead) and Dylan (solutions eng) for immediate provisioning and sizing.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

+1 650-555-0123

Team — Elaine at FinTechCo is seeing a production outage from a campaign spike. They’re currently on hosted and need an urgent plan to restore production SLAs. Key asks:
- Immediate mitigation to reduce errors and latency
- Assessment of whether Dedicated will be required (48–72h turnaround)
- If they sign a short-term commit, can we expedite Dedicated provisioning (and what’s the minimum commit)?

Context: attached logs show queuing at the frontend with a handful of model OOMs. They mentioned compliance constraints that might push to Private later, but immediate priority is availability.

Please:
- Dylan: can you propose a quick config (batching/prefix cache + temp quota bump) we can apply now?
- Marcus: pricing + provisioning path for a 2–6 week Dedicated trial — what’s the minimum lead time and commit?
- Neha: if Private VPC is requested, what legal and networking timelines should we tell them?

I’ve scheduled a 09:40 quick sync with the FinTechCo ops team. Will escalate if we need infra help.

Thanks — Vanessa

- Minimum commit for expedited provisioning: 2-week monetary commitment (prepay) or a short MPA addendum. I can fast-track the procurement approval internally.

Dylan — can you confirm whether we can push a hosted concurrency bump and prefix cache changes without rolling model variants? If yes, we buy a bit more breathing room while we spin Dedicated.

I’ll prepare a short commercial summary to send to the customer after the 09:40 sync.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Zhao <elaine@fintechco.com>, Raj Patel <raj@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Next steps — temporary mitigation + expedited Dedicated trial

Elaine / Raj — thanks for the call earlier. Quick summary and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned:

Summary of what happened
- 08:30 PT: campaign triggered burst; hosted concurrency exceeded expected sustained QPS and caused queuing + a small number of model OOMs.
- Impact: increased p95 latency (~3s) and elevated 5xxs causing customer-visible errors.

Immediate mitigation (applied):
- Temporary hosted concurrency bump (applied, effective)
- Enabled prefix KV caching for hot keys (reduced re-computation for repeat requests)
- Applied conservative request rate-limiting at the edge to prevent backend OOMs

Proposed short-term path (recommended)
1) Start a 2-week Dedicated trial (Fast-Track):
   - Marcus to send MPA addendum and trial pricing (20% introductory uplift)
   - We can provision a 1–2 GPU Dedicated pool within 48 hours of signed addendum + prepayment
2) Parallel: begin Private/VPC discovery only if you need network isolation & audit controls (Neha will scope timelines)

Required from FinTechCo to proceed
- Sign MPA addendum (I attached a draft: draft_mpa_v0.3.pdf)
- Confirm expected steady-state QPS and peak concurrency target for sizing
- Provide billing contact for procurement and an internal network diagram only if you want VPC exploration

I attached the incident snippet and traffic graph for your internal teams. Marcus and I will follow up with a short commercial summary and an action checklist. If you want, we can start provisioning the Dedicated pool as soon as we have the signed addendum + prepay.

Next actions (owners)
- FinTechCo: Sign addendum + confirm QPS (OWNER: Elaine)
- Marcus: Send commercial summary + DocuSign link (OWNER: Marcus)
- Dylan: Send config writeup for the temporary hosted settings we applied (OWNER: Dylan)
- Neha: Draft Private/VPC timeline if requested (OWNER: Neha)

Doc links & attachments:
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/FT-2026-0042
- Incident playbook: https://redwood.box.com/s/incidentplaybook
- Attachments: incident_log_snippet.txt, traffic_graph.png, draft_mpa_v0.3.pdf

We’ll stand by to expedite.
